description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Thran Dynamo.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.
